name_note: GTDB splits the classical genus Butyricicoccus into several genera, of which Butyricicoccus_A is one, so the cited findings are about Butyricicoccus in the broad sense.

sentences.text: The genus Butyricicoccus was named for five isolates obtained from the caecal content of a broiler chicken during a study of butyrate-producing microbiota.
A genome-scale reassessment noted that the genera Butyricicoccus and Agathobaculum were established largely on 16S rRNA gene phylogeny, and proposed transfers plus a new genus Parabutyricicoccus.
That reassessment places the genus in the family Oscillospiraceae, whose members are described as prominent anaerobic bacteria of the gut microbiota with numerous taxa capable of butyrate production.
A study quantified Butyricicoccus in stools of patients with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease and reported lower numbers in inflammatory bowel disease than in healthy subjects.
